I sat down with Sam Thompson again and we talked about how anyone could shamelessly copy the strategy behind Cluely, the $120 million AI company that blew up in just three months. We broke down their viral content machine. Then we got into one of the most asymmetric opportunities right now, cloning big SaaS companies like Salesforce, AppFolio, and RentManager using lightweight AI tools. We talked about how to find their customers, reverse-engineer their best features, and undercut them by 99%. We also talked about how to spin Cluely’s playbook into your own clipping farm or content agency, and how to build a high-margin service business off new business registrations. Finally, we explored where AI still falls short, and why taking action always beats overthinking.

You can find Sam on X/Twitter (https://x.com/ImSamThompson) and check out what he’s building at https://www.unlimitedcontent.com/ and https://hummingbirdfood.co/

Full story behind the sugar hummingbird biz is in this episode → https://youtu.be/UcFBcfrmC2k


Enjoy!
